originalTitle: Meta employees ordered ‘attorney/client privilege’ hats while fighting child safety disclosures

content: Meta’s lawyers have argued that certain evidence should be withheld from public view on the grounds of attorney-client privilege in the ongoing lawsuits over alleged harm to teens’ safety and mental health. Lawyers suing the company said this week that the label has been applied far too broadly, while pointing to a recently unsealed document showing that the team behind launching Instagram’s Teen Accounts in 2024 put in an order for baseball caps that simply said “a/c priv.” [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/meta-ac-priv-hats.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] The lawyers suing Meta argue the Project Nido (an internal name for the Teen Accounts team) swag is part of “culture of privilege abuse at Meta” aimed at keeping the research it’s conducted internally on teen harm out of the public eye, an issue that Mark Zuckerberg discussed after internal data on Instagram’s effects leaked in 2021. US District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers already called some of Meta’s privilege redactions “entirely inappropriate” in an order last month. She pointed out one example where Meta’s lawyers tried to cast a discussion about a slide deck and whether or not to publish certain data as a discussion of attorney legal advice, deciding that based on testimony from the trial, their reticence about publishing was more of a business decision focused on preventing leaks. [Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Clipboard_09-24-2026_02.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] Meta de-designated about 65,000 previously withheld or redacted documents in April 2025, after discovery, which the plaintiffs say came too late for them to use in depositions. Now Meta has requested time through the end of this year to re-review other privilege redactions it’s made, while the plaintiffs’ lawyers say a neutral party should be appointed to lead the review, paid for by Meta. [Media: https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/28683080-2026-09-21-stipulation-with-proposed-dckt-3509-1/]

chineseContent: Meta 的律师辩称，在正在进行的涉嫌损害青少年安全和心理健康的诉讼中，基于律师与委托人之间的特权，某些证据应该从公众视野中隐藏起来。起诉该公司的律师本周表示，该标签的应用范围过于广泛，同时指出最近公布的一份文件显示，2024 年推出 Instagram 青少年账户的团队下了一份棒球帽订单，上面只写着“a/c priv”。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/meta-ac-priv-hats.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 起诉 Meta 的律师辩称，Project Nido（青少年账户团队的内部名称）赃物是“Meta 滥用特权文化”的一部分，旨在使其内部针对青少年伤害进行的研究远离公众视线，Mark 认为这一问题是“Meta 滥用特权文化”的一部分。扎克伯格在 2021 年 Instagram 影响的内部数据泄露后进行了讨论。美国地区法官伊冯·冈萨雷斯·罗杰斯 (Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers) 已在上个月的一项命令中称 Meta 的一些特权修改“完全不合适”。她指出了一个例子，Meta 的律师试图将有关幻灯片以及是否发布某些数据的讨论作为律师法律建议的讨论，并认为根据审判的证词，他们对发布的沉默更多是一种专注于防止泄密的商业决策。 [图片：https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Clipboard_09-24-2026_02.jpg?quality=90&strip=all] 发现后，Meta 于 2025 年 4 月取消了约 65,000 份之前扣留或编辑的文件，原告称这些文件来得太晚，无法在证词中使用。现在，Meta 已请求在今年年底之前重新审查其他特权修订，这是我的职责
